title: Ringing
description: You can only play [blue]1[/blue] card this turn.
smart_description: You can only play [blue]1[/blue] card this turn.
notes: Applies a Ringing affliction to all cards in the player's hand. The player can only play 1 card per turn while Ringing is active. Automatically removes itself at the end of the turn and clears all Ringing afflictions from cards.
